comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
A future Memorial Album consisting of seven items which must be created by modifying base items with transmutation alchemy and "Sophia" points. They are:

Poetry Anthology transmutes to -> Old Play Notes
Widow's Cup - obtained when discovering Halicarnassus (new discovery)
Iron-plated Paneling transmutes to -> Special Blue-gray Metal Paneling
Plain Flag transmutes to -> Flag of Ancient Persia
Acanthus transmutes to -> Ancient Persian Decor
Greek Goddess Amulet transmutes to -> Sailors' Goddess Charm
Silver Horseshoes transmutes to -> Sailors' Money Charm

The reward is Ancient Queen's Ship Handling Guide. Details on its page.

Unfortunately, Maris server suffers from a nerf by KOEI -- Plain Flag should be available from the Maritime Guild Union shop, but was removed on our server and turned into a rare ship race reward and junk cove drop.

As of this posting, the Silver Horseshoe is also impossible to obtain since its Treasure Hunt is unlocked by a specific World Clock event that we have yet to get.

But in case any of those details ever change, you are thus informed. Cheers, and great online voyaging to you.

Source/Pics: wittyship.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-1219.html (MA data), gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?BoostItem/SpecialEffect (EX effect listing for MA reward)

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Note: this MA is now out in Maris but cannot currently be completed for the above-stated issue re: Silver Horseshoes. (The Plain Flag was released in a treasure cove, so its MA item can be made by some.)

Controlling the World Clock is difficult, but using Alias' options at the Frankfurt Tavern to get a result of 'advancing forward' seems to have some influence. I personally suggest sending kindly-worded support tickets in requesting that the GMs consider manually setting the world clock to the appropriate era for Horseshoes.

Cheers, and best of luck with this album's completion.

comments.author: MarcoS
comments.body: Im not fully aware how to control world clock via Alias but I have (and recomend others do the same) choose the bottom answer to Alias' questions to move the world clock forward. Thanks.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Extra note: for those who wish to complete this Legacy theme's discoveries, be advised that the lower right / 4:00 position discovery has a hidden requirement before it can be found.

I am told by players wiser than me that you must have discovered Kuh-e Rahmat from the [DBLNK:99994544] quest; if you do not have it in your discovery list then its slot will be darkened/blacked out when you're combining clues and it can NEVER be obtained until you complete that discovery quest.

Most likely this applies to any Legacy themes involving an inland discovery. Fortunately the above MA items are not locked by individual discoveries so apart from the (ahem) 'issue' regarding the horseshoes, it won't affect those trying to perform the above recipes.

Well, you are thus warned. Cheers!
